summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a press release detailing additional orders received by its subsidiary, Robotic Assistance Devices (RAD), from healthcare and construction customers. The orders include three RIO 180 solar powered security trailers for California healthcare facilities and two RIO Mini units integrated with the SARA AI platform for an East Coast construction project. This is a routine operational update regarding customer expansion and revenue growth, not a special situation. No financial terms, board actions, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing is purely informational with no transaction or strategic event triggering classification.
